title: 相量形式的 KVL：RLC 串联电路的电压表读数
statement: RLC 串联电路接正弦电压源 U̇_s = 50∠0° V（有效值），ω = 1000 rad/s，R = 30 Ω，L = 80 mH，C = 25 µF。电压表 V_1、V_2、V_3 分别测 R、L、C 两端的电压。
求 V_2、V_3 的读数和 b 点对地电压（即 L、C 串联部分的电压）的有效值，并解释读数之间的关系。

questions.ask: 电压表 V_2（电感）的读数 = ?
电压表 V_3（电容）的读数 = ?
b 点对地电压 U_b（L 与 C 串联部分）的有效值 = ?
questions.explain: U̇_L 与 U̇_C 反相：U̇_b = U̇_L + U̇_C = j80İ − j40İ = j40İ，模 40 V，而不是 80 + 40 = 120 V。

questions.ask: V_2 的读数（80 V）比电源电压（50 V）还大，原因是？
choices: U̇_L 与 U̇_C 相位相反、部分抵消，所以总电压可以小于某个元件的电压
相量形式的 KVL 在这里不成立
questions.explain: KVL 是相量相加：U̇_s = U̇_R + U̇_L + U̇_C。相量图上 U̇_L（超前 İ 90°）与 U̇_C（滞后 İ 90°）方向相反，合成后只剩 40 V，所以 U_s = √(30² + 40²) = 50 V，比 U_L 还小。电路没有谐振（X_L ≠ X_C）。

hints: 先算 X_L = ωL、X_C = 1/(ωC) 和串联阻抗 Z = R + j(X_L − X_C)。
串联电路电流相同，各电压表读数 = 电流有效值 × 各自的阻抗模。
电压表读的是有效值（相量的模），它们之间不满足代数相加，要画相量图。

en.title: KVL in phasor form: voltmeter readings in a series RLC circuit
statement: A series RLC circuit is driven by U_s = 50∠0° V (rms), ω = 1000 rad/s, R = 30 Ω, L = 80 mH, C = 25 µF. Voltmeters V_1, V_2 and V_3 measure the voltages across R, L and C.
Find the readings of V_2 and V_3 and the rms voltage of node b to ground (the voltage across L and C together), and explain how the readings are related.

questions.ask: rms value of U_b (node b to ground, across L and C in series) = ?
questions.explain: U_L and U_C are in antiphase: U_b = U_L + U_C = j80·I − j40·I = j40·I, magnitude 40 V — not 80 + 40 = 120 V.

questions.ask: V_2 reads 80 V, more than the 50 V source. Why?
choices: U_L and U_C are in antiphase and partly cancel, so the total voltage can be smaller than one element's voltage
Phasor KVL does not hold here
questions.explain: KVL adds phasors: U_s = U_R + U_L + U_C. In the phasor diagram U_L (90° ahead of I) and U_C (90° behind I) point in opposite directions, leaving only 40 V, so U_s = √(30² + 40²) = 50 V, smaller than U_L. The circuit is not at resonance (X_L ≠ X_C).

hints: Compute X_L = ωL, X_C = 1/(ωC) and the series impedance Z = R + j(X_L − X_C).
The series current is common; each voltmeter reads the rms current times that element's |Z|.
Voltmeters read rms values (phasor magnitudes); they do not add algebraically — draw the phasor diagram.
solution: **4. L and C together.** U_b = U_L + U_C = 40∠36.87° V, rms **40 V**.
**5. KVL check.** U_R + U_b = 30∠−53.13° + 40∠36.87°; the two are perpendicular, magnitude √(30² + 40²) = 50 V = U_s. Note 30 + 80 + 40 = 150 V ≠ 50 V: rms values do not satisfy KVL.
